about_the_game:
The forces of evil are once again threatening the world, only one way to stop them: reach the top of a mysterious giant tower. Don't ask why, it's the prophecy.

But it won't be that easy, they will try to stop you. Your people are building a town and assembling an army at the bottom of the tower to hold off the invaders. They will however need your support: you'll have to send them resources scavenged out of the tower.

Will you reach the top before your defense fails?

Furniture Are Just Raw Material In Assembled Form

The Tower is full of monsters and riches. Collect loot and break the furniture to fill up your inventory.
Efficiency is key: your stamina is limited and you'll only be able to do so much before needing to rest for the day.

Make The Most Out Of Your Day

At regular intervals waves of raiders will attack your Town in an auto-battler kind of event. The raider army grows larger every day and your defense needs to be strong enough to stop them at all time, so make sure you extract enough building material and weapons for your guards out of the Tower.

Aerial Loot Extraction

What's the best way to extract loot from a sky-high tower? Easy, just throw it all out the window.

Down next to the Tower your Town is being built. Use the resources you've dropped to build and defend your settlement. Buildings provide all sort of upgrades. Some will improve your hero's capabilities in the Tower, and some will help your Town defenses. Decide how to allocate your resources depending on what you need the most at a given time.

Use Magic Gems to Turn the Tides of Battle

Everise will challenge you to a game of constant fine balancing and optimization. The hero you send in the tower can't die, but you'll have to be efficient to maximize the amount of resources you can grab before your daily health & stamina pool is depleted. To help you with this you'll collect Magic Gems allowing you to cast a variety of spells to get the upper hand on the battlefield.

Tactical Turn-Based Combat

Spells can either be 'Slow' or 'Quick', meaning they either resolve before or after enemy actions. Use this to your advantage to outwit your enemies and get rid of them in a way that will require the minimal amount of time and effort: evade their attacks, move them around, trick them into attacking one another, be creative... and deceitful!

Here's a summary of what you can expect to do:

  • Enter the tower and make your way across different rooms and levels to reach higher floors.

  • Manage your health and stamina pool efficiently to cover as much ground as possible before inevitably running out of energy for the day.

  • Fight enemies in a turn-based combat system. When you perform an action, all enemies do so as well.

  • Assemble a deck of magic Gems to cast powerful spells and change the state of battle.

  • Collect resources and equipment by pillaging every room you go through. Break apart furniture, destroy decorations, steal riches and loot your vanquished enemies to fill your inventory.

  • Manage your limited inventory space, decide what you need the most: more resources to improve your Town or extra tools and equipment to facilitate your progression in the Tower.

  • At the end of every floor you'll get access to a balcony where you can empty your inventory. Drop down the resources you've accumulated for recycling in Town.

  • Build and improve the Town to fortify it and unlock new upgrades.

  • Assemble a line-up of guards and defensive contraptions to protect the Town against endless waves of raiders.

  • When a new day start, go back to your hero inside the Tower and progress further up. Your objective is to reach the top of the Tower before raiders take over your Town.

name: Everise
short_description: Reach the top of the Tower before raiders destroy your town. Scavenge the furniture and loot monsters to collect resources along the way, then empty your inventory down balconies to upgrade and defend your town!
